title: Pending withdrawal tokens in `redeem()` affect share price
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Pending withdrawal tokens in the `redeem()` function are still considered in the share price calculations. Since `totalSupply` and `_totalAssets` are not updated to reflect the pending withdrawals:  ```solidity         // Transfer shares from owner to vault         balanceOf[owner] -= shares;         balanceOf[address(this)] += shares; ```  The share price would be incorrect for profit/loss that happens later.
